annotations.title: Workers compensation premium with experience mod calculator

description: Estimate a workers compensation premium from payroll by class code, your experience mod, schedule credits or debits, premium discount and expense constant, and show what the mod adds or saves. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

classes.description: Payroll by class code. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for payroll by class code. Unknown is not the same as zero.

label.description: Class code or description (no names needed). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for class code or description (no names needed). Unknown is not the same as zero. Optional reference label; no names or personal data.

payroll.description: Annual payroll in this class (US dollars). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for annual payroll in this class. Unknown is not the same as zero.

rate.description: Rate per $100 of payroll (your figure) (US dollars). From your policy, quote or state rating bureau.

discount.description: Premium discount. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for premium discount. Unknown is not the same as zero.

expense.description: Expense constant (US dollars). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for expense constant. Unknown is not the same as zero.

mod.description: Experience modification factor (×). From your experience rating worksheet; 1.00 is average, below 1 is a credit, above 1 is a debit.

schedule.description: Schedule credit (−) or debit (+). Enter as a percent number. Enter a credit as a negative percent.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

name: buscalc_workers_compensation_premium_with_experience_mod

checkURL.description: Link that replays this calculation on https://buscalc.com/sumtru/verify/. Null when the inputs hold free-form text or the link would be too long.

notes.description: Reference-value notes first, then model notes and the standard limit statement.

referenceValues.description: One entry per official reference value in play: the official figure, the figure used, status official or user, source, effective date and the note text.

sealURL.description: Where a saved record of this result can be sealed with an independent timestamp.
